description: This file defines the EmployeeDependentService class, which manages employee dependents by interfacing with the data access object (DAO) and providing methods for CRUD operations and searches within the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentService
classes.description: Service class providing employee dependent management operations including retrieval, saving, deletion, and search, with exception handling.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependentDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeDependentDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: setEmployeeDependentDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeDependentDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of dependents for a specific employee identified by employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dependent for an employee by employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: saveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Saves or updates an EmployeeDependent entity.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Deletes specified dependents associated with an employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Performs a search for dependents based on provided filter parameters, with exception handling.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of dependents matching search criteria, with exception handling.
